tools.name: list_launches
tools.description: Products launching on PebbleLaunch on a given UTC day (default today), ranked by human votes. Featured items are labelled.

tools.name: get_launch
tools.description: One launched/scheduled product by slug: details, launch day, votes, rank, and the badge snippet once live.

tools.name: get_launch_calendar
tools.description: Seats left per upcoming UTC day (free queue, premium, featured) and the next day with a free seat.

tools.name: submit_product
tools.description: Submit the user's own product for a free launch day on PebbleLaunch. Only submit products the user owns and has asked you to list. Returns an id, a one-time status_key (save it) and ownership-proof options. Next: add ONE proof on the product's domain (a .well-known file, a meta tag, or a DNS TXT rec

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Status of a submission you made (needs its id + status_key). While ownership is pending this re-checks the proof (at most once a minute). Set resend_email to re-send the maker's confirmation link.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_product · Private data: submit_product · Public sink: submit_product, check_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_product · Private data: submit_product · Public sink: submit_product, check_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
